title: O Holy Night
writers: Adolphe Adam (music) and Placide Cappeau (French lyrics, 'Cantique de Noel', 1847); English lyrics by John Sullivan Dwight

evidence.note: Adam set Cappeau's 1847 French poem to music the same year, but the English version sung today is John Sullivan Dwight's adaptation, published in 1855.

famous_use: Often said to be the first song ever broadcast by radio, in Reginald Fessenden's 1906 Christmas Eve violin broadcast, though the article notes this is not formally documented.
